0x0007D8.en: 「At my current level...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x000849.en: 「Gah!@　So this is where it ends...!!」

0x0008D1.en: 「Damn it!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x000A32.en: 「Oh dear...@　how uncool of me, honestly!」

0x000AFB.en: 「Ngh! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x000B36.en: 「Screwing up in a place like this...!@　This isn't funny...」

0x000B8A.en: 「I blew it...!@　Nothing to do but bail...」

0x000BFE.en: 「Gah! I've got no choice but to retreat!!」

0x000CDB.en: 「This is as far as I go... I leave the rest to you.」

0x000D87.en: 「No good, I've taken too many hits... Retreating!」

0x000DD4.en: 「Well, this is a mess. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000E12.en: 「Kyaa! I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000E59.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x000F04.en: 「Ngh... So I'm the one who becomes a shooting star... Ejecting!」

0x001040.en: 「U... ngh! So this is the end...!」

0x0010AD.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x0010F4.en: 「I'm sorry, the rest is up to you.」

0x001129.en: 「Damn it! Is this the limit of my power...!」

0x001215.en: 「To go down in a place like this...@　I'm still not good enough...!」

0x001263.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! We're pulling back!」

0x0012DC.en: 「Sorry about this!@　I'm gonna slip out of here...!」

0x00131E.en: 「Sorry, I'm leaving the rest to you!」

0x00134D.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x00138B.en: 「Well, well. So this is where it ends.」

0x0013BA.en: 「I can't go any further. I'll be taking my leave.」

0x001445.en: 「Careless of me...@　I'll withdraw for now...!」

0x0015AB.en: 「Ejecting now...@　Ngh...! Not a pretty exit, is it...」

0x001669.en: 「Guhhh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x0017D8.en: 「So I've still got a ways to go...!」

0x0018AD.en: 「Guess I've got no choice but to retreat...!」

0x00191C.en: 「Th-the Earth... it's wrapped in a membrane of light...!」

0x001954.en: 「...This is different from when the Ruina@　deployed the Atrum Exterior...!」

0x0019D4.en: 「Y-yes... and what's more, we can still see the Earth...」

0x001A1D.en: 「The light seemed to spread not from the South Pole,@　but from somewhere over the Middle East...」

0x001AC8.en: 「But the only ones capable of something like this@　would be them...」

0x001B24.en: 「In any case, let's get a grasp of the situation.@　Eun, first try to make contact with the Hagane.」

0x001BB2.en: 「Vice Captain, we're heading for the rally point of the@　Operation Reconquista Combined Space Fleet.」

0x001C2F.en: 「Understood. I only hope nothing's gone wrong...」

0x001C72.en: 「Captain, contact with the surface is impossible.@　It doesn't seem to be an EA type, but rather@　that membrane of light.」

0x001CF9.en: 「So in that respect, it's the same as the@　Atrum Exterior...」

0x001D61.en: 「Could it be that descent to the surface is also...」

0x001D8F.en: 「Two o'clock, ten degrees below! The Operation@　Reconquista Combined Space Fleet is approaching!@　They appear to be in combat with someone!」

0x001E59.en: 「They're quite far off from the rally point.@　Perhaps they're being pushed back by the enemy?」

0x001EC4.en: 「We're moving to support them. All hands, battle stations!」

0x001F6E.en: 「This ship, the Venerable, and the Gascogne!」

0x001FAE.en: 「To take this much damage@　in so short a time...!」

0x001FF8.en: 「Hiryu Kai approaching!@　Straight ahead, twelve o'clock, ten degrees up!」

0x00204E.en: 「To the Bravely Ark.@ This is Colonel Lefina Enfield, commander of the@ Steel Dragon Squadron. We'll cover you from here.」

0x0020F0.en: 「This is Colonel Humphrey Inez, commander of the Reconquista fleet.@ Thanks for the aid - we'll try another counterattack from here.」

0x0021C5.en: 「Given your ship's condition, I judge this too dangerous.@ Withdraw from the battle zone at once.」

0x002221.en: 「If we don't stop Baral here, the damage will spread@　elsewhere. We should wipe them out with our combined forces.」

0x0022C9.en: 「That's right. The membrane of light covering the Earth@　is their doing too, produced by a massive structure@　called the Garden of Baral.」

0x002381.en: 「I'll explain later.@　For now, let's join forces and repel the enemy.」

0x0023E4.en: （Hm, so even the hardest head in the Space Force has@　softened up. I'd braced myself for a jab or two...）

0x002479.en: 「All units, launch at once!@　Defend the Bravely Ark and the other two ships to the last!」

0x0024D8.en: 「The Earth's wrapped in something like a barrier...!」

0x00255B.en: 「Unlike the Atrum Exterior,@　at least we can still see the Earth.」

0x0025C3.en: 「The Earth getting sealed in a barrier twice now...@　what in the world is going on, seriously.」

0x00262E.en: 「The Ruina, Baral... they all do things way too over the top.」

0x00267E.en: 「Kouta, there's something I want to look into on my own.@　It'll put some limits on the OG sensors, but is that all right?」

0x002704.en: 「Fine by me, but what are you checking?」

0x002735.en: 「I'll tell you later, if I get confirmation.」

0x002766.en: 「...Gilliam, there's a KyuKiOh at twelve o'clock.@　If we don't pin it down fast, the fleet could be wiped out.」

0x0027EC.en: 「I know.@　Ghost One to all units. Super robots, attack the KyuKiOh.@　Everyone else, cover the fleet.」

0x0028C9.en: 「High-speed object approaching! Straight in from three o'clock,@　twenty degrees below! It's a fish-type Custos!」

0x002947.en: 「Custos... they're hardly here to save us.」

0x0029A3.en: 「Master, if that came flying in from the direction of@　that giant structure...」

0x002A05.en: 「Then it's siding with Baral, just as I thought.」

0x002A36.en: 「Ghost One to all units.@　This will be our first real battle@　against the Custos.」

0x002AB7.en: 「Their strength is an unknown. Whatever you do, don't let your guard down.」

0x002AFD.en: 「The KyuKiOh is pulling out of the battle zone!」

0x002B37.en: 「...They withdrew more easily than I expected.」

0x002B83.en: 「The fish-type Custos are still here.@　Make sure to defend the Bravely Ark and the other two ships.」

0x002C03.en: 「All enemies have retreated.@　No signs of any remaining foes.」

0x002C85.en: 「Then maintain a strict all-around watch.@　Eun, contact the Bravely Ark.@　We'll ask Commander Humphrey for further instructions.」

0x002D58.en: 「This is based on intel from the Reconquista fleet,@ plus what Viletta, myself, and others have surmised, but...」

0x002E00.en: 「The barrier from Baral's risen stronghold, the 'Garden@ of Baral,' blankets the whole sky except the Ruina's field,@ and it's still holding.」

0x002EBA.en: 「Its strength can withstand a direct hit from the H-MAPW...@　and like the Atrum Exterior,@　it's blocking access to the Earth.」

0x002F6B.en: 「In all likelihood, getting from the surface out to space@　won't be easy either.」

0x002FC4.en: 「Then what about moving by spatial transfer...?」

0x002FFB.en: 「The Guests will prove it before long, but...@　I believe it's impossible.」

0x003066.en: 「Then can't we just hit it with more power@　than the H-MAPW?」

0x0030CE.en: 「It might be worth a try, but...@　a man named Son Ganglong, who dwells in the Garden@　of Baral, flatly declared it would be useless.」

0x003195.en: 「Even so, it'd be reckless to underestimate a power that@　could raise the Garden of Baral and deploy a barrier like this.」

0x003215.en: 「Yeah... the Earth's likely been sealed again by arts@ beyond human ken. After all, contact with the surface@ is impossible now.」

0x0032BD.en: 「Son Ganglong likely means to carry out his Total Human@　Shikai Plan after leaving Earth's people nowhere to run.」

0x003352.en: 「...Hey, Roar says he wants to talk about@　Baral's barrier...」

0x0033C6.en: 「Got it. Go ahead and use that monitor there.」

0x003461.en: 「That's Roar...@　he came from another world, and he's the original owner@　of Compati Kaiser and the Roar Armor.」

0x003513.en: 「Inside the Roar Armor's crystal.@　But he can talk with us like this, too.」

0x003587.en: 「Huh... he's kind of like a familiar.」

0x0035C4.en: 「Oh, you might be right about that.」

0x00362A.en: 「When I looked at the Earth through Baral's barrier,@　something felt off to me.」

0x003689.en: 「And when I checked with the OG sensors...@　I noticed that a certain something had vanished.」

0x00371F.en: 「Cities and Federation military bases.@　Not all of them, though.」

0x00378A.en: 「Don't tell me Baral wiped them out!?」

0x0037CA.en: 「That's one possibility, but...@　it was as if the image had been doctored -@　several cities and bases were cleanly erased.」

0x00388E.en: 「I don't know the reason, but...@　there's a strong chance we're not seeing@　the Earth as it truly is.」

0x003934.en: 「...Is there anything the vanished cities and bases have in common?」

0x00397D.en: 「There is, but...@　there are so many that it's actually hard to narrow down.」

0x0039D3.en: 「Still, Baral's intent has to be behind it.」

0x003A4A.en: 「I've no proof, but I think it's some kind of message to us...@　a warning, most likely.」

0x003ACE.en: 「Defy Baral, and your towns and bases will vanish...@　is that what it means?」

0x003B33.en: 「Then wouldn't they just erase everything?@　That'd be a lot clearer.」

0x003B8C.en: 「Michiru's idea isn't off the mark.@　It's probably that sort of message.」

0x003BEE.en: 「I don't really get it, but one thing's for sure -@　Baral are a far bigger deal@　than I thought.」

0x003C6F.en: 「So what do we do from here?」

0x003CA3.en: 「Colonel Lefina and the others are still discussing that.@　Now then... everyone, return to your posts.」

0x003D20.en: 「...Haaah, this time we're the ones getting@　thrown off the Earth.」

0x003D82.en: 「By the way, Ibis... did you find Irui?」

0x003DE1.en: 「Shouko and the others searched too, but...」

0x003E22.en: 「We checked the internal camera feeds too, but@　there was no sign of her anywhere...」

0x003E84.en: 「All we can say is she vanished from inside@　the room, just like that...」

0x003F0E.en: 「...We'll be heading for Heaven's Gate.@　What do you intend to do?」

0x003F7C.en: 「For now, the Custos and Chokijin won't move@　unless someone nears the Garden of Baral. And if@　there's no way to return to Earth in sight...」

0x004051.en: 「Then we'd like to take part in@　Operation Reconquista as well.」

0x0040F9.en: 「To leave no threat at our backs... and to retake@　the moon, we need to settle things with the Guests@　here and now.」

0x004197.en: 「If you'll have us, Commander,@　put us to use as reinforcements.」

0x004233.en: 「We can't contact the surface, and we've@　already been stripped of our commissions, but...」

0x0042A1.en: 「...True enough. Very well, I accept your offer.@　But if something happens on Earth,@　you go back to your original mission.」

0x00436B.en: Paris - Earth Federation Joint Chiefs of Staff

0x004399.en: Earth Federation Joint Chiefs of Staff

0x004400.en: 「Our attack may have been the trigger, but...@　sooner or later, Baral meant to do that anyway.」

0x004498.en: 「I'll take that as your excuse.@　Now, what did you want?」

0x0044E8.en: 「As the barrier went up, the Antarctic ward shrank@　in diameter and rose in altitude.」

0x00454A.en: 「We believe it changed shape to keep the skies@　over the Antarctic from being sealed off.」

0x0045C7.en: 「And wary of Baral, the Ruina have grown quiet.@　For our side, you could call this@　an opportunity.」

0x004666.en: 「I see... so this is a nudge.」

0x004697.en: 「Yes. We'd like you to hurry and join@　Operation Icebreaker.」

0x004702.en: 「We have our own concerns here, but... fine.@　On one condition, though.」

0x0047B1.en: 「Hand it over? They're not even@　under our jurisdiction at the moment.」

0x00480D.en: 「Hmph... then let me put it differently.@　You pursue the Hagane too. But the@　seizure will be ours to make.」

0x0048AC.en: 「Rather convenient for you... but@　we have our own reputation to consider.」

0x00490E.en: 「The arrest and handover@　should be left to us alone.」

0x00495B.en: 「Reputation, at this late hour...?@　Are you telling us to call off pursuit of the Steel Dragons?」

0x0049D9.en: （Hmph, so he's fishing...@　But then, so am I.）

0x004A5E.en: 「Marshal, you can't be serious...!?@　Handing the Hagane to the Gaia Sabers...!」

0x004AD2.en: 「It's a game of deception, my boy.@　Now, let's see how he plays his hand...」
